question: Cheraw, popularly known as bamboo dance, is a traditional cultural dance of which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mizoram**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bamboo dances are traditional dances that involve bamboo in some way, including:
 
 
• Cheraw
 
 
• A traditional dance from Mizoram, India, where six to eight people hold bamboo staves in pairs and clap them rhythmically.
 
• Female dancers step in and out of the bamboo formations while the male dancers move the bamboo.
 
• The Cheraw is considered one of the oldest dances in Mizoram and is often performed during festive occasions. 
 
 
 
• Tinikling
 
 
• A traditional folk dance from the Philippines where at least two people beat, tap, and slide bamboo poles on the ground and against each other.
 
• Dancers step over and in between the poles.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some dances of some states 
 
• **Jharkhand:** Chhau, Jhumar, Paika
 
• **Uttarakhand:** Chholiya, Chakri, Natti
 
• **Manipur:** Lai Haraoba, Manipuri Classical Dance, Thang-ta
